title: A Backdoor, a Signal, and the Bill
description: Five top stories and twelve briefs follow a backdoored coding extension, a shared opt-out signal, a market turn against AI spending, and tighter safety answers.

claude-code-cursor-backdoor.verification_scope: Phorion analysis and Ars Technica's account; how the account was taken is still unexplained

ai-training-optout-signal.verification_scope: Company announcement and reporting of who will adopt the signal; it does not undo past crawling

ai-capex-cracks.verification_scope: Reported earnings and market moves; Blackstone's rating view is a forecast

altman-math-onslaught.verification_scope: Podcast remarks paraphrased, not verified verbatim; Yang-Mills detail remains unpublished

openai-teen-violence-safeguards.verification_scope: Company announcement of measures rolling out over coming weeks; effect not yet reported

google-suncatcher-first-response.verification_scope: Reports of the first checkout; later radiation tests and 2027 launches are still ahead

chatgpt-pro-limits-api-credits.verification_scope: Reported announcement and Simon Willison's note on expiring API credits

doordash-agent-orders.verification_scope: Earnings-call remark; a few hundred agent orders against millions of daily deliveries

proton-cancels-ai-reinterviews.verification_scope: Account from six employees and a meeting recording

pope-leo-disarm-ai.verification_scope: Speech paraphrased; a call for a future Geneva step, not a ban already in force

dartmouth-provost-ai-disclosure.verification_scope: Report of the resignation and the advisory finding; Ars original could not be opened and the item follows the feed summary

doj-ghost-students.verification_scope: Justice Department announcement as reported; Ars original could not be opened

fujifilm-lto-tape.verification_scope: Company investment announcement as reported; Ars original could not be opened

altman-ram-data-center.verification_scope: Podcast remark paraphrased, not a verified verbatim quotation

cisco-legacy-code-tokens.verification_scope: Profile; the 98 percent figure is the headline's claim

bytedance-genai-departures.verification_scope: Report of departures; not an official ByteDance statement

collective-experience-learning.verification_scope: Team-published results on 96 robots; not independently reproduced

oxr-document-parsing.verification_scope: Publisher scores; model not run and license not checked

unified-training-paper.verification_scope: Abstract only; not peer reviewed; 48-hour catch-up

tao-proof-abundance.verification_scope: Paraphrase of a published excerpt; not a response to Altman's latest interview
